thread:
Maya: Quick design review — two things I noticed in the dark theme build: chart tooltips have low contrast on the new navy background, and the token-heatmap green almost disappears at 14% density. Can we look at palette + copy for the dark toggle?

Josh: Can you drop a screenshot or the Figma frame pls?

Maya: Screenshot + figma here: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/dark-theme-playground — see frame 'Charts - Dark v3' and 'Token Heatmap'. Also pasted current tokens: 

```css
--bg: #0b0f13;
--panel: #0f1720;
--muted-text: #98a0ad; /* 3.8:1 on panel */
--tooltip-text: #c9d6e7; /* 3.2:1 on panel -> fail for small text */
--heatmap-low: #052b14;
--heatmap-mid: #0f6b3a;
--heatmap-high: #2fe07a;
```

Sam: Ok the tooltip text is below 4.5:1 for body text. For small UI text we want >=4.5:1 per AA (or >=3:1 for large UI?). Let's bump tooltip to ~#E6F0FA or change tooltip bg to a slightly lighter panel.

Aria: Re: heatmap, green with low luminance on dark bg loses perceptual steps. Recommend a sequential palette with consistent luminance steps e.g. ['#062b10', '#0b5530', '#13784a', '#2aa56e', '#6fe2a9'] — keeps hue but increases perceived difference. Also consider colorblind-safe variants (replace green with purple-blue ramp) for optional toggle.

ThemeBot: Accessibility scan: tooltip-text #c9d6e7 on panel #0f1720 = contrast 3.2:1 (FAIL). heatmap-mid #0f6b3a on bg #0b0f13 = 1.9:1 (FAIL). Suggested corrections: tooltip-text -> #e6f3ff, heatmap-mid -> #13784a.

Josh: From an implementation POV, Recharts supports linearGradient stops so we can map an explicit hex array. Example (React):

```jsx
const stops = ['#062b10','#0b5530','#13784a','#2aa56e','#6fe2a9'];
<LinearGradient id="heatmapGradient">{stops.map((c,i)=>(<stop offset={i/(stops.length-1)} stopColor={c}/>))}</LinearGradient>
```

Sam: Also a tiny copy nit for the toggle. Current label: `Dark mode`. Suggestion: change to `Use dark theme` (more action-oriented) and aria-label="Toggle dark theme". Keeps it clear for screen readers.

Aria: Focus/keyboard note: when toggling theme, we lose visible focus on the toggle because outline blends with panel. Proposal: add 3px ring using `--focus-outline: rgba(110,180,255,0.18)` and ensure contrast on focus ring against both light/dark.

Maya: Love these suggestions. Two questions: 1) do we ship both green and purple heatmap variants behind a feature flag? 2) final swatch set for charts (line/area/stacked) — can we pick 5 accessible swatches that keep visual hierarchy?

Josh: 1) Easy to feature-flag via query param + store preference. 2) Proposed chart swatches (dark-friendly): ['#6cc5ff', '#9bd48b', '#ffd08a', '#ffb18a', '#d6b8ff'] — all tested at panel bg for >=4.5:1 when used for primary lines (we'll use thicker strokes).

ThemeBot: Contrast checks: '#6cc5ff' on panel = 4.9:1, '#9bd48b' = 4.6:1, '#ffd08a' = 3.9:1 (borderline for small lines), '#ffb18a' = 3.7:1. Suggest making the amber darker to hit 4.5:1 or use a thicker stroke for those colors.

Sam: For amber, try '#e6a85a' -> that bumps contrast to ~4.6:1.

Aria: Figma updates: I'll add the heatmap sequential palettes + a purple-blue alternate, update tooltip copy + focus ring. Will tag components that need token updates.

Maya: Action items: @Josh - update CSS tokens + chart mapping PR; @Aria - push Figma swatches + annotate accessible text sizes; @Sam - finalize toggle copy + aria-label in i18n strings. I'll test the deploy once PR is up. :thumbsup:

Josh: On it, I can have a draft PR today.

Sam: I'll add a quick unit test for contrast utility in the frontend.

Aria: Done — Figma frames updated and comments added.

Maya: Thanks team — feel cleaner. We'll validate in staging and re-run ThemeBot. :sparkles:
